text.p: Smith & Wesson, the Springfield, Mass.-based maker of handguns for sporting, law enforcement and military use, said its handguns sold for commercial use will be shipped from the factory with a Master Lock Gun Lock.

"We believe it is common sense for Smith & Wesson to encourage gun owners to utilize the full range of firearms safety precautions and procedures available to them," the company said. The gun locks will be standard on weapons shipped beginning Sept. 2.

"While we recognise that no single safety device or solution will apply universally to all gun owners, we believe that the inclusion of the Master Lock Gun Lock with Smith & Wesson handguns reflects our commitment to the concept of responsibility," the company said.
The Master Gun Lock, which was first introduced in 1969, generally sells separately for $10 to $14.
A Smith & Wesson spokesman said the handguns sold with the gun lock will have a slight increase in price.
For more information, contact Smith & Wesson at 1-800-331-0852, ext. 2904.
